policy: Preserve the font-defined whole octabox geometry. Upstream Graphite2 1.3.14 preloadGlyphs2/preloadAll6 zeros its slanted whole bounds when no glyph in the font has subboxes. The unchanged non-preloaded public reference retains the documented bounds. A part on unused glyph0 restores all modes; real-font outputs are identical across modes and receive no exception.
